original_statements: Theorem 1 retains all three assumptions, the spectral moment condition, b/n+n/b^2 tending to zero and the p-degree chi-square limit. Theorem 2 retains all four neighborhood conditions, derivatives through order two, Riemann integrability, envelope, nonsingular moment Jacobian and existence of a consistent asymptotically normal solution sequence with full covariance formula. Theorem 3 retains the supremum over real CDF arguments and convergence in sampling probability. Theorem 4 retains both conclusions, h:R^p to R^s, its Jacobian rank at theta0 and the printed infinite block-size limit despite importing a zero limit.
source_passages: All 26 source entries and six auxiliary passages were checked against pages 5-10,12-13,18-20. The real weakly stationary process, general nonzero moment vector, estimating functions and true-parameter moment condition are distinct. Full-data and disjoint-block periodograms retain normalization 1/(2*pi*length), while the printed overlapping formula retains 2*pi/b. All signed nonzero Fourier frequencies and even-length endpoints remain as printed. The SEL supremum, empty-feasible-set value zero, N^N log-ratio, full-data M-estimating equation and smooth profile maxima match the source.
assumptions: Assumption 1 is fourth-order stationarity with a uniform 4+delta moment and the weighted alpha-mixing sum, using the same delta. Assumption 2 requires componentwise bounded variation only at theta0. Assumption 3 requires positive definiteness of the sum of the two full spectral covariance terms; the fourth-order cumulant contribution is neither discarded nor separately made positive definite. Derivative regularity in Theorem 2 is additional. Strict stationarity, zero mean, linearity and Gaussianity are not added.
resampling: The fitted-parameter bootstrap samples N independent elements from the indexed overlapping collection at hat-theta_n, preserving multiplicity and the common block length. The smooth-function bootstrap instead resamples entire theta-indexed block-statistic functions, using shared sampled indices across theta before profile maximization. The induced probability P_* is a subscript-star symbol, while likelihood/statistic stars are superscripts. Neither procedure constructs a resampled time series.
dependencies: All 30 direct theorem uses, 70 related connections and 26 local prerequisite lists were checked. The basic SEL limit has no full-data M-estimator, derivative regularity or overlapping bootstrap. The M-estimator theorem has no block-size restriction or block likelihood. The smooth profile does not inherit the pointwise fitted collection or fixed-fit bootstrap objective. Whittle-specific Corollary 1, simulation models, sunspot application, computational dual formulas and proof results are not general theorem prerequisites.
